versions.author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
versions.revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 30 of 45 stations of this ecoregion pass. 25 reference curves use local stations, 3 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 3 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
